user_reported_bug: Two heartbeat loops fire simultaneously during EXECUTE — iter 278's per-file loop inside `_do_execute`'s Parliament call AND iter 308's generic loop inside `_with_budget`. During parallel file fan-out (3 files), this produced 1 phase-level + 3 file-level heartbeat events every 6s — duplicate/near-simultaneous pairs. User demand: deletion-only cleanup; keep the generic _with_budget heartbeat (iter 308), remove iter 278's per-file loop; do NOT improve the surviving one; add regression test proving zero duplicates.
